caption:
The video captures the interior of an aircraft cabin during a weightless phase, through a fisheye lens curving the padded walls, where several occupants in dark flight suits float or rest. In the right foreground a woman holds a flexible tripod with a small camera and a clear plastic bag, her hair drifting upward. A seated woman in the center foreground raises a phone, while another lies in a push-up pose on the left floor.

The central focus is a woman already airborne at the start with one arm raised; across the clip she hovers near the center, tucking her legs, drawing her arms in front, then raising one arm again toward the ceiling. The right-side woman stays in the same position, rotating slightly and making small shifts of her arms and the floating bag. A man in a cap near the left wall and the background figures drift slightly, keeping their locations.

Banners reading Zero-G, SPACE, MICOS and a blue Pancake poster line the cabin walls.
relations: The central airborne woman tucks her legs and draws arms inward from her raised posture, then raises one arm again.
The right woman with the tripod and bag stays floating, rotating slightly and making small arm and bag shifts.
Background figures, including the man in the cap, drift slightly while maintaining their general locations in the weightless cabin.
The right woman's hair drifts upward in the weightless environment as she shifts her arms and the floating bag.
